description:
Thrilled to announce the initial public release of **Pixel Camera v1.0.0**! 

This release backports next-generation Google Pixel 11 camera features—including **Camera Looks**, **Viewfinder Quick Access Controls**, **5x Optical Telephoto Portrait**, and the **Creator Suite**—to older Tensor devices (**Pixel 6 through Pixel 10**), completely usable **without root**!

---

## What's New in v1.0.0

### 1. Ten Signature "Camera Looks" (Sauce & Tomte)
* **Real-time Viewfinder Rendering**: Live preview and hardware-accelerated processing of all 10 color and tone styles.
* **Full Preset Spectrum**:
  * **Original** — Classic true-to-life Google HDR+.
  * **Natural** — Subtle softening with neutral, true skin tones.
  * **Shadows** — Punchy, moody contrast and deep blacks.
  * **Vanilla** — Warm, golden-hour radiance with soft ambient glow.
  * **Editorial** — Kodachrome-inspired magazine colors and rich contrast.
  * **Velvet** — Saturated landscape tones reminiscent of Fuji Velvia.
  * **Classic** — Timeless analog film aesthetic inspired by Kodak Portra.
  * **Digi** — Early-2000s compact digital camera punch and flare.
  * **Black Tie** — Fine-grain, high-contrast monochrome dynamic range.
  * **Minimal** — Clean, desaturated Scandinavian aesthetic.
* **Universal Tensor Engine**: Automatic fallback execution on Mali-G715 / Immortalis GPU and multi-threaded Halide CPU workers on Tensor G1–G4 devices without vendor HAL dependencies.

### 2. Viewfinder Quick Access Controls & Discrete Tick-Slider
* **Custom Viewfinder Shortcuts**: Assign Left and Right quick shortcuts directly in Camera Settings (`Settings → Fast access → Quick access controls`).
* **On-Screen Tick Slider**: Tap anywhere on the viewfinder to reveal the vertical 10-tick slider—scrub through all Looks seamlessly without diving into menus.
* **Haptic Feedback**: Tactile feedback on slider detents with persistent preference memory across app restarts.

### 3. 5x Optical Telephoto Portrait Mode & 10x Quick Zoom
* **True 5x Optical Telephoto Bokeh**: Unlocks physical periscope portrait captures (`RAW_TELE` + `PD_TELE`) on Pixel 7 Pro, 8 Pro, 9 Pro, and 10 Pro—breaking the 1.5x / 2.0x digital crop restriction.
* **Dedicated 10x Quick Zoom Viewfinder Button**: Instant 1-tap Super Res Zoom toggle on the viewfinder (`0.5x, 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x`) powered by Google's `NativeZoomPlus` and `NativeFusionZoom` pipelines.

### 4. Pixel Camera Creator Suite
* **Teleprompter HUD (`biotite`)**: Viewfinder script overlay with auto-scrolling, customizable WPM speed, and inline script editing.
* **Live Audio VU Meter (`mica`)**: Real-time microphone input volume indicator rendered over the viewfinder.
* **Social Framing Guides (`slate`)**: Quick grid overlays for 9:16 vertical video, 1:1 square, and standard ratios.

### 5. Dual Installation (Standalone Clone APK)
* Renamed package namespace to `com.google.android.GoogleCameraEng` allowing side-by-side installation with your stock Google Camera app.
* No root, Magisk, or Bootloader unlocking required.

---

## Hardware Compatibility Matrix

| Device Generation | SoC | Looks | Quick Access | 5x Portrait | 10x Zoom | Processing Mode |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Pixel 11** | Tensor G6 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | Native TPU + HAL |
| **Pixel 10 / 10 Pro** | Tensor G5 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | Hybrid TPU / GPU |
| **Pixel 9 / 9 Pro / 9 Pro XL** | Tensor G4 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | GPU / TPU Fallback |
| **Pixel 8 / 8 Pro / 8a** | Tensor G3 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | Mali-G715 GPU |
| **Pixel 7 / 7 Pro / 7a** | Tensor G2 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | GPU / Halide CPU |
| **Pixel 6 / 6 Pro / 6a** | Tensor G1 | ✅ | ✅ | 4x opt (Pro) | ✅ (Pro) | Halide CPU Worker |

---

2. Open **Morphe Manager** on your Android device (or Morphe Desktop on PC).
3. Import the `.mpp` patch and select your official **Pixel Camera 11.0.073** APKM.
